completion:
Record your findings in accordance with the established database standards and definitions.
3. Clearly indicate priorities and immediate safety risks, and provide accurate chronological data.
4. Capture everything with images.
5. Flag everything. Let us do our part. # Draft Scope Item 4.304.3 BALL INFORMATION SYSTEM

Each building shall be assigned an INBS ID and an OBRA ID by the CPS. Buildings shall be included in the Intranet Network Building System (INBS) based on BASA inspection findings. The INBS ID, by UCI, parcel number, address, date of inspections, and other relevant details shall be maintained in the INREL information database.

Physical examiners shall flag inspected buildings through the use of pink tags. Pink tags must include the date of inspection, the building name and INBS ID, and the EXAMINER'S name and date and signature, and a list of NONCOMPLI
